recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow correction to active operation source that aligns the ActivityDefinition half of the original $apply subject change with the issue resolution and leaves the already-correct PlanDefinition action source untouched.
issue_request: FHIR-18196 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by CDS. It requested adding a 0..1 subject CodeableConcept to PlanDefinition.action, documenting that an action subject overrides parent/root PlanDefinition subjects, documenting by-type subject resolution during realization including ActivityDefinitions, and changing the $apply patient parameter to subject with cardinality 1..*.
initial_application: Git commit 2b9949c7e4ad0746b24d36bd1172bf7c46feae2f initially applied GF#18196 by changing PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition spreadsheets and the PlanDefinition $apply request example. Current generated source already has PlanDefinition.action.subject[x] with CodeableConcept, cardinality 0..1, and the requested override/resolution comment, and both PlanDefinition/$apply and ActivityDefinition/$apply use subject 1..*. The ActivityDefinition/$apply documentation still referred to resolving subjects as the subject of the PlanDefinition.
additional_context: ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and their operation list files reference the $apply OperationDefinitions, so the edited OperationDefinition is in current build scope. Later FHIR-29211 expression-context guidance is already represented on the combined branch and does not change this issue's subject-resolution requirement. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-18196 community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed source/activitydefinition/operationdefinition-ActivityDefinition-apply.xml so the ActivityDefinition/$apply subject parameter says provided subjects resolve as the subject of the ActivityDefinition rather than the PlanDefinition. No PlanDefinition.action edit was needed because current source already implements the requested element and documentation.
